system.effect: When you Seek while touching a continuous stone surface, you may use vibrations to detect a creature moving on that same surface within 10 feet. Use the ordinary Awareness check and detection rules. This sense can locate a creature only as Hidden, never Observed, and cannot detect a motionless or airborne creature. It does not convey speech, appearance, or identity.
system.description: With a hand against the floor, you can feel the approach that the air refuses to reveal.
